statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-120141 (PostgreSQL materialized set-returning function type confusion executes arbitrary code) in 16.16 on the PostgreSQL 16 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120141/ lists 16.16 as the fixed release for major version 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/19cff54329fdb9051044be0d98c4ad0167077914 on the REL_16_STABLE branch, which changes src/backend/executor/execSRF.c (plus regression tests) so that a materialized set-returning function with a dynamic RECORD return type gets a fresh slot and tuple descriptor on each invocation; it is tagged Security: CVE-2026-120141 and Backpatch-through: 14; that commit is in the REL_16_16 release tag and not in REL_16_15. The DHI postgresql16 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes. We checked the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, in every published postgresql16 package for Alpine 3.23 on both x86_64 and aarch64 (checksums verified against the package index): 16.16-r0 reports PostgreSQL 16.16 and carries the fix, while the earlier builds 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0 report 16.13, 16.14 and 16.15 and are affected. 16.16-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix. Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD lists CVE-2026-120141 under its 16.16-r0 secfixes.

CVE-2026-120141 (PostgreSQL materialized set-returning function type confusion executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 17.12: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120141/ and the 17.12 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/. 17.12 is the fixed release listed for major version 17. Alpine's postgresql17 17.12-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch is the upgrade to upstream 17.12 and lists CVE-2026-120141 under its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/ce22298320177ae25085d86fbf3b4fc1150c16a2/main/postgresql17/APKBUILD. The DHI postgresql17 17.12-r0 package for Alpine 3.23 is built from that APKBUILD and the upstream 17.12 source release, and its postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on both x86_64 and aarch64. Every earlier published build for Alpine 3.23 (17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0 and 17.11-r0) is an earlier upstream release whose server binary reports that older version, so it is affected; 17.12-r0 and later carry the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-120141, a type confusion in materialized set-returning functions such as json_populate_recordset() that lets a database user execute arbitrary code, in 17.12 (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120141/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-120141, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/). Earlier 17 releases are affected. The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0.
